package_title: Constitutive Nonlinearity 第 10-14 周数学核心资料包

scope.canonical_model: small-strain rate-independent associative J2 plasticity with linear isotropic hardening; one-dimensional linear combined hardening for cyclic verification
included: plane-stress local constraint and Schur condensation
Voce nonlinear hardening local Newton example
verification V00 through V11 with paired answers
excluded: complete finite element solver or element library

canonical_contract.path: 01_核心算法/00_五周总览与材料接口.md
canonical_contract.material_call: update(total_strain_np1, committed_state, material, options) -> stress_np1, C_alg_np1, trial_state_np1, diagnostics
canonical_contract.state_rule: Every trial is recomputed from the same committed state; commit only after global convergence.

canonical_invariants: f_trial <= tolerance implies no plastic state update
alpha_np1 = alpha_n + Delta_gamma and alpha is nondecreasing
linear isotropic J2 uses denominator 3G + H_iso
J2 plastic strain increment is deviatoric
algorithmic tangent differentiates the implemented discrete stress update
plane stress solves sigma_zz = 0 and does not truncate a 3D stress afterward
rejected trial states never replace committed state
